answer: Temporal response clustering. Each identity carries a hidden lantern of behavioral traces—timestamps, latency patterns, phrasing rhythms—and the system flags accounts whose traces correlate too tightly with known or suspected clusters. A whisper of shared micro-timing across supposedly unrelated agents triggers deeper pairwise comparison against prior flag history. Every flagged identity then faces a mirror test: replaying its recorded interactions to measure divergence from its own claimed history, with any match to a cluster raising a persistent risk score.
